info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Jobs-v2-spec
info.description: The Job Applications Listing API provides a comprehensive overview of all job applications within the careers management system. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of available job postings and associated application details. Common consumers of this API include HR personnel, hiring managers, and talent acquisition teams looking to manage, review, or analyze job applications. Use this API to efficiently access job application data and streamline the recruitment process.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of job applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a comprehensive list of job applications associated with the user. You can use various query parameters to filter the results according to your needs.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving job applications. This should include the necessary parameters to filter or specify the job applications being requested. The body is expected to be in JSON format.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the list of jobs.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsRequest.description: Represents the request body for the GET operations related to applications and jobs.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsResponse_200.title: Job Response

status.description: Indicates whether the job operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the job.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the job operation.

state.description: The current state of the job operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the job, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the job operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit of the job operation.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for a job operation request.
